# gcxtras_sta_topic (Resource)

Manages a Genesys Cloud Speech and Text Analytics Topic.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gcxtras_sta_topic" "example" {
  name         = "Customer Complaint"
  description  = "Detects when customers express complaints"
  strictness   = "72"
  participants = "External"
  dialect      = "en-GB"
  tags         = ["complaints", "cx"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dialect` (String) The dialect for the topic (e.g. en-US, en-GB, de-DE, fr-FR, etc.).
- `name` (String) The name of the topic.

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the topic.
- `participants` (String) Which participants to analyze. Valid values: External, Internal, All.
- `phrases` (Block List) List of phrases to detect for this topic. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--phrases))
- `program_ids` (List of String) List of program IDs this topic is associated with.
- `strictness` (String) The phrase strictness level (1-99). Controls how closely spoken words must match the defined phrases. Higher values require closer matches.
- `tags` (List of String) List of tags associated with the topic.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--phrases"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phrases`

Required:

- `text` (String) The phrase text to detect.

Optional:

- `strictness` (String) Override strictness for this specific phrase (1-99). If not set, uses the topic-level strictness.
